title: RyBench: Runtime Verification Benchmarking Framework over Publish/Subscribe Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.22401v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous systems built as distributed, node-based systems communicate via publish/subscribe middleware. Runtime Verification (RV) tools are used to monitor those systems against formal specifications, receiving monitored events through the pub/sub channel. An RV tool's practical value depends on its monitoring throughput capacity and verdict latency, besides its correctness, so a systematic benchmarking setup is needed to evaluate how efficiently these tools run. This paper presents RyBench, a pub/sub-based benchmarking framework that acts as a synthetic event publisher in place of a monitored system, providing a common benchmarking setup. RyBench separates benchmark generation, serialization, and transport into distinct components, enabling the combination of different event-generation strategies, data formats, and transport layers. We also evaluate the framework's throughput capacity across these configurations using Open Simulatio

translated_title: RyBench：基于发布/订阅网络的运行时验证基准测试框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.22401v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：以分布式、基于节点的形式构建的自治系统通过发布/订阅中间件进行通信。运行时验证（RV）工具用于依据形式化规范对这些系统进行监控，并通过发布/订阅通道接收被监控的事件。除了正确性之外，RV工具的实用价值还取决于其监控吞吐量能力和判决延迟，因此需要一个系统化的基准测试设置来评估这些工具的运行效率。本文提出了RyBench，一个基于发布/订阅的基准测试框架，它充当合成事件发布者来替代被监控的系统，从而提供统一的基准测试环境。RyBench将基准测试生成、序列化和传输分离为独立的组件，使不同的事件生成策略、数据格式和传输层能够灵活组合。我们还使用Open Simulatio（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了RyBench——一个基于发布/订阅的基准测试框架，它作为合成事件发布者替代被监控系统，并通过将事件生成、序列化和传输解耦为可灵活组合的独立组件，为运行时验证工具的吞吐量与判决延迟评估提供了统一的标准化测试平台。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RyBench, a publish/subscribe-based benchmarking framework that acts as a synthetic event publisher in place of a monitored system and decouples event generation, serialization, and transport into composable components, providing a standardized testbed for evaluating the monitoring throughput and verdict latency of runtime verification tools.
